title: Countable additivity of the co-area identity over disjoint Borel pieces of an injective continuous chart
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, Z ⊆ ℝ^{n+1}, and let Z_q (q ∈ ℕ) be pairwise disjoint Borel subsets of ℝ^{n+1} with ⋃_q Z_q = Z. Let ψ : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^P be continuous on Z and injective on Z, F : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ Borel, and φ, g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞] arbitrary. Suppose that for every q the function t ↦ ∫_{ψ(Z_q ∩ F^{−1}(t))} φ dHⁿ is a.e.-measurable for Lebesgue measure on ℝ and ∫_ℝ ∫_{ψ(Z_q ∩ F^{−1}(t))} φ dHⁿ dt = ∫_{ψ(Z_q)} g dH^{n+1}. Then t ↦ ∫_{ψ(Z ∩ F^{−1}(t))} φ dHⁿ is a.e.-measurable and ∫_ℝ ∫_{ψ(Z ∩ F^{−1}(t))} φ dHⁿ dt = ∫_{ψ(Z)} g dH^{n+1}. Here Hᵏ = μHE[k] and all integrals are lower integrals in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Z : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (Zs : ℕ → Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (ψ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (F : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ) (φ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), ContinuousOn ψ Z → InjOn ψ Z → Measurable F → (∀ q, MeasurableSet (Zs q)) → Pairwise (fun p q => Disjoint (Zs p) (Zs q)) → (⋃ q, Zs q) = Z → (∀ q, AEMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in ψ '' (Zs q ∩ F ⁻¹' {t}), φ x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t : ℝ, (∫⁻ x in ψ '' (Zs q ∩ F ⁻¹' {t}), φ x ∂μHE[n]) = ∫⁻ x in ψ '' Zs q, g x ∂μHE[n + 1]) → AEMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in ψ '' (Z ∩ F ⁻¹' {t}), φ x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t : ℝ, (∫⁻ x in ψ '' (Z ∩ F ⁻¹' {t}), φ x ∂μHE[n]) = ∫⁻ x in ψ '' Z, g x ∂μHE[n + 1]
